title: Deep feature learning for automatic tissue classification of coronary artery using optical coherence tomography

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep feature learning for automatic tissue classification of coronary artery using optical coherence tomography》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】This study aims to develop a robust and fully automated tissue classification method by using the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) as feature extractor and comparing the predictions of three state-of-the-art classifiers, CNN, random forest (RF), and support vector machine (SVM).

evidence.text: This study aims to develop a robust and fully automated tissue classification method by using the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) as feature extractor and comparing the predictions of three state-of-the-art classifiers, CNN, random forest (RF), and support vector machine (SVM).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Deep feature learning for automatic tissue classification of coronary artery using optical coherence tomography》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Automatic classification of the coronary artery layers (intima, media, and scar features) is important for analyzing optical coherence tomography (OCT) images recorded in pediatric patients.

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】OCT has been known as an intracoronary imaging modality using near-infrared light which has recently been used to image the inner coronary artery tissues of pediatric patients, providing high spatial resolution (ranging from 10 to 20 μm).
